owned_invariants: Phi_1 is the minimum of D over potentials and is attained by the returned potential.
Every enumeration step is charged to the budget.
boundaries: Exponential tree enumeration is bounded by the graph limits and the step budget (BudgetExceededError).

score.level_basis: Non-trivial exact algorithm: L1 defect, the primary obstruction Phi_1 by spanning-forest enumeration per component with Paper 005 tie-breaking, the idempotent projection P_S, and an explicit search budget with a typed failure.

basis.G1: AuthorityEffect: None and a unique URN; complete provenance envelope for the ported logic (pfp_lab/core/PROVENANCE.md: source path, git blob, committed SHA-256, last commit, a table of every change); the differential test maps every verdict field back to the unmodified source. Not A: no signed receipt of the source.
basis.G2: Exact profile: all arithmetic on Fraction; claims must be Fraction on declared edges; per-component minimum is equal to the product enumeration because the defect is a sum over components. Property tests check Phi_1 <= D(s), D(P_S(s)) = Phi_1, P_S idempotence, gauge invariance and homogeneity; the differential test agrees with the unmodified Paper 005 code. Not A: optimality is tested, not proved here.
basis.G3: Every expected failure is a typed exception with a stable code (AdmissionError, BudgetExceededError, UnknownPackError) or a typed verdict; no assert in production code (Ruff S101, AST test) and the whole suite passes under python -O; no bare or broad except (Ruff BLE001/E722). Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: Unit and boundary tests for every branch, negative tests for each refusal, run under pytest and under python -O. Hypothesis properties and a 300-case differential test against the Paper 005 oracle. Mutation R = 51/52 (see mutation_accounting).
basis.G5: Functions are single-purpose; complexity measured per function. Metrics: worst function: cyclomatic 6, cognitive 8, nesting 3; metrics ceiling A+.
